name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-08-08, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
